patterns.description: Scroll-triggered reveals evoking slow page turns. Content drifts upward like a page being lifted, then settles with paper-weight momentum.
motionOrder: major media surface or full-page illustration
patterns.gsapPattern: gsap.from(el, { y: 60, duration: 2.25, ease: 'power3.out', scrollTrigger: { trigger: el, start: 'top 85%' } })

buttonTransitions.description: Outline/ghost CTA transitions to solid fill on hover with the weighted patience of a bookmark sliding into place.
buttonTransitions.transition: background-color 1.125s cubic-bezier(0.15, 0.85, 0.25, 1.0), color 1.125s cubic-bezier(0.15, 0.85, 0.25, 1.0), border-color 1.125s cubic-bezier(0.15, 0.85, 0.25, 1.0)

opacityLinkInteraction.description: Nav links fade like ink drying — slow, inevitable dimming on hover.

gsapRules.safeInitialState: transform-only — use y/x/scale only. NEVER opacity:0 in from(). Opacity:0 hides content before ScrollTrigger fires, causing blank sections on load and during screenshots.
gsapRules.safeExample: gsap.from(el, { y: 60, duration: 2.25, ease: 'power3.out', scrollTrigger: { trigger: el, start: 'top 85%' } })
gsapRules.unsafeExample: gsap.from(el, { opacity: 0, y: 40 }) — DO NOT USE

recommendations: Use transform and opacity for scroll-reveal animations to enable hardware acceleration
Apply will-change: transform on sticky scroll panels during scroll phase only, remove after
At 1.875s max duration, consider prefers-reduced-motion media query to skip long transitions for accessibility
